title: Special Topics in General Relativity; Gravitational-Wave Physics
description:
Prerequisite: To follow the course, students should be already familiar with the material covered in an introductory General Relativity course. It is not necessary to have followed a course in astrophysics and/or cosmology.

Recommended: PHYS675

An introduction to the theory and phenomenology of gravitational waves, notably from binary systems composed of black holes and neutron stars, but also from phenomena in the Universe dominated by gravity.
